verdict.rationale: xAI documents multiple official, first-class integration paths for coding agents: the Grok Build CLI for agentic coding (grok-docs-2), tool/function calling and remote MCP client support (grok-docs-8, grok-docs-9, grok-docs-12), an official MCP server for docs access (grok-docs-24), an OpenAI-compatible REST API that lets Grok slot into the broad agent-framework ecosystem built for that spec (grok-docs-20), and enterprise integrations via Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry (grok-docs-22, grok-docs-23). Community evidence corroborates real-world usage in Cursor and via the Grok Build CLI (grok-comm-1, grok-comm-11, grok-comm-13), confirming these integrations work in practice, though some commenters note code-quality/reliability caveats unrelated to integration availability itself. Missing for 10: explicit documented SDK/plugin listings for widely-used third-party agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT) and independent benchmarking of integration robustness beyond Cursor/Grok Build.
